source.originalText:
Spellcasting
Drawing on the essence of nature itself, you can cast spells to shape that essence to your will. See chapter 10 for the general rules of spellcasting and chapter 11 for the druid spell list.
Cantrips
At 1st level, you know two cantrips of your choice from the druid spell list. You learn additional druid cantrips of your choice at higher levels, as shown in the Cantrips Known column of the Druid table.
Preparing and Casting Spells
The Druid table shows how many Resonance Points you have to cast your druid spells. A spell's base RP cost is twice its Resonance Rank (Rank 0 cantrips cost 0), modified by explicit class features and current Dissonance. You regain expended RP according to the Resonance recovery rules.
You prepare the list of druid spells that are available for you to cast, choosing from the druid spell list. When you do so, choose a number of druid spells equal to your Wisdom modifier + your druid level (minimum of one spell). The spells must be of a level for which you have Resonance Points.
For example, if you are a 3rd-level druid, you have 7 Resonance Points. With a Wisdom of 16, your list of prepared spells can include six spells, and they can be of 1st or 2nd level in any combination. If you prepare the Rank 1 spell cure wounds, its base cost is 2 Resonance Points before explicit specialization or Dissonance modifiers. Casting the spell doesn't remove it from your list of prepared spells.
You can change your list of prepared spells when you finish a long rest. Preparing a new list of druid spells requires time spent in prayer and meditation: at least 1 minute per spell level for each spell on your list.
Spellcasting Ability
Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for your druid spells, since your magic draws upon your devotion and attunement to nature. You use your Wisdom whenever a spell refers to your spellcasting ability. In addition, you use your Wisdom modifier when setting the saving throw DC for a druid spell you cast and when making an attack roll with one.
Spell save DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier
Spell attack modifier = your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier
Ritual Casting
You can cast a druid spell as a ritual if that spell has the ritual tag and you have the spell prepared.

Spellcasting Focus
You can use a druidic focus as a spellcasting focus for your druid spells.

automaticCards.name: Shapeshifting
automaticCards.cost: One shift use
automaticCards.effect: Assume an unlocked prepared form or revert early. Apply engine HP, equipment, concentration and reserve rules. This is not a spell and cannot copy monster stat blocks.

source.originalText:
Shapeshifting
At 1st level, you gain the ability to transform into various animal forms. Shapeshifting is Aethel's native druidic transformation discipline and functions according to the following rules:

Activation and Duration
You can use a bonus action to assume a beast form. You can remain in beast form for 10 minutes per use. You then revert to your normal form unless you expend another use of this feature. You can revert to your normal form earlier by using a bonus action on your turn.

Uses per Day
At 1st level, you can use your Shapeshifting ability twice per long rest. You gain additional uses as you reach higher levels, as shown in the Shapeshifting Uses column of the Druid table.

Available Forms
At 1st level, you can transform into any of the Base Druid Forms listed below. At 11th level, you gain access to Arch Druid Forms. At 10th level, you gain access to Hero Druid Forms specific to your chosen Circle.
Limitations While Transformed
While in beast form:
You cannot cast spells unless specified by your Hero Class
Your ability to speak is limited (only preserved in arch/hero forms)
You retain your mental ability scores (Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma)
You gain the physical traits of the chosen form as specified

fullClassSource.protectedInterfaceOriginal: Once per turn, spend 1 Blood Gauge while casting to prevent 1 Dissonance; the Agent routes Weave strain through blood rather than gaining free casts.
fullClassSource.rpAuthority: Explicit fallback: Cleric CoreV2 curve ×0.5, halves upward
engine: Blood Gauge (BG) starts and ends each encounter at 0, capacity 3; Spill Control raises capacity 6 while known. Once on your own regular turn, a weapon attack that damages a hostile living creature grants 1 BG. Hemorrhage Slash uses this same trigger, not an additional one. Explicit critical/kill/refund features can add more, but total BG gained is capped 2 per round. Self-inflicted damage, allies, summons, helpless captives and repeated damage to a corpse never generate BG. Blood is an encounter resource, not a currency carried into rest.

Dexterity governs weapon attacks; Intelligence governs hemomancy save DC and M. S scales from Crimson Agent class level. A weapon technique includes only its printed attacks, with normal weapon die plus Dexterity (or Strength when that weapon requires it). No free attack is implied by attack-speed wording. Class BG and RP are separate. Once per turn when casting an ordinary spell, optionally spend 1 BG to prevent 1 of that cast's Dissonance gain, minimum 0; never reduce RP this way.

Your Bleed is a physical ongoing effect on a living, non-bloodless creature: 1d4 damage at the start of each of its next 3 turns, then ends. It is not a new attack and generates no BG or procs. Refresh duration instead of stacking; Blood Echo expressly allows two independent instances, maximum. An Action by the victim or an adjacent creature using a healer's kit ends all your Bleeds on that victim. Apply physical resistance/immunity normally. Track remaining ticks and creator per instance. Allied healing versions from Bloodweaver cost RP and never count as hostile Bleeds for detonation, spreading or generation.

One Blood Mark at a time on a living target with your Bleed, except Phantom Strike, which explicitly may apply the mark without Bleed. It does not add a free Bleed. Marks last 5 of your regular turns, expire on encounter end or if the target dies, and never create damage by themselves. Rupture requires the target still within 60 ft and line of effect; it spends the mark. A mark does not defeat cover, planar boundaries or bloodlessness. Bloodtrail has its own tracking limits.

Veinweaves are self buffs unless their card expressly allows an ally. They require concentration and one may be active. Crimson Harmony is an explicit exception permitting two Veinweaves as one linked concentration burden; a failed concentration check ends both. A non-Veinweave concentration effect replaces the whole group. BG is spent on activation; no upkeep unless printed. Damage-sharing is redirection before mitigation, not extra damage: apply each recipient's own defenses once and never redirect the redirected portion again.

The healing, execution and denial text below deliberately bounds the source's vague percentage/instant-kill claims. HP sacrificed is direct loss, bypasses temporary HP and defenses, cannot be redirected, and cannot reduce the donor below 1. Only a willing ally can donate. HP sacrifice is never damage for class triggers. No class feature here restores the dead or removes Wounds.

At level 1 learn the core Blood Gauge/Bleed rules automatically. Blood Mark and Veinweaver's Core remain selections; Quickblood can be selected and used without a second unlock tax. Veinweaver's Core improves that foundation as printed. Standard scheduled acquisition applies. Bloodbound Edge is automatic 9. At 10 choose Bloodweaver, Shadow Operative or Thirstborn; its Final Cut is automatic 20. Duplicate Hemostasis names are separate Arch and Bloodweaver IDs.

Capacity clarification: Blood Gauge automatically reaches capacity 6 at class 9. Spill Control allows reaching 6 early but never raises the cap above 6. This new explicit gate ensures a later 5-BG Final Cut can be used without an optional capacity selection. Gain cap 2/round and encounter reset 0 still apply.
workedExample: Bard-style example becomes Agent 5: DEX 16, INT 14, S 2, M 2, BG 0/cap 3, full class RP. Select Hemorrhage Slash, Quickblood, Blood Mark, Shroud at 1; Blood Tithe and Vital Targeting at 2; Rupture and Spill Control at 3. Capacity is now 6.
Turn 1: Hemorrhage Slash hits for ordinary weapon damage+2d6, applies Bleed, and gains 1 BG (not 2). Bonus Action Blood Mark pays 1 BG: balance 0. Target takes its first 1d4 Bleed on its next turn.
Turn 2: ordinary weapon attack hits and gains 1 BG. Keep the mark and save resources; Bleed ticks independently and grants no BG.
Turn 3: a second weapon hit gains 1 BG: balance 2. Bonus Action Quickblood spends 1 BG: balance 1. It gives movement, not another attack.

Turn 4: Rupture is an Action, pays 1 BG: balance 0 and consumes the mark. Target fails CON: takes(S+1)d8=3d8. Rupture is not a weapon hit, so it generates no replacement BG. Any remaining Bleed continues.
After the encounter BG becomes 0. Blood Tithe's used short-rest charge and spent RP do not refresh without an actual rest.
balanceQuestions: Does early setup take too many turns for one mark?
Can Bloodweaver protect without sacrifice loops or infinite healing?
Are denial and execution limits sufficient against bosses and multiclass dips?

cards.name: Arterial Cut
cards.effect: A critical weapon hit applies your Bleed. If it already has your Bleed, extend one instance by 2 ticks, maximum 5 ticks remaining. This damage never generates further BG.

source.originalText: Arterial Cut: Critical hits apply Bleed for 3 turns; Bleed duration +2 turns.

cards.name: Blood Tithe
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self after a hostile bleeding creature dies within 30 ft
cards.effect: Regain HP equal to M+class level after a creature bearing your Bleed dies. It must have been an active hostile combatant; no ally, summon, captive or corpse farming.

source.originalText: Blood Tithe: Killing a bleeding target restores 10% of max HP.

cards.name: Veinweaver's Core
cards.effect: You can dismiss a Veinweave without an action and switch to another known Veinweave using its normal activation. Once/short rest reduce the BG cost of one Veinweave by 1, minimum 1. The basic one-Veinweave capacity is part of your engine, not locked behind this selection.

source.originalText: Veinweaver's Core: Unlocks use of Veinweaves (1 active at a time).

cards.name: Vital Targeting
cards.effect: Add S damage to a weapon hit against a target that has not perceived you or is within 5 ft of another conscious hostile-to-it ally. This is flat damage, not a critical die, and requires an actual weapon hit.

source.originalText: Vital Targeting: +15% damage to flanked or unaware enemies.

cards.name: Shroudstep
cards.effect: After taking the Hide Action and moving at least 10 ft while hidden, gain+1 AC. You still need valid concealment and a successful ordinary Stealth check; this feature does not grant invisibility.

source.originalText: Shroudstep: After using stealth movement, gain +10% dodge for 1 turn.

cards.name: Hemorrhage Slash
cards.effect: Make one weapon attack. On hit add S d6 damage of the weapon type and apply Bleed. The usual once/turn hit trigger grants 1 BG; this card grants no separate BG.

source.originalText: Hemorrhage Slash: A precise strike that deals moderate damage and applies Bleed status to the target, generating 1 Blood Gauge point.

cards.name: Veinweave: Quickblood
cards.effect: Start a Veinweave: gain+10 ft Speed and ignore nonmagical difficult terrain. Once during its duration you may draw or stow one weapon without using your object interaction. It grants no attacks or Actions.

source.originalText: Veinweave: Quickblood: Consume 1 Blood Gauge point to increase your movement and attack speed by 15% for 3 turns.

cards.name: Blood Mark
cards.rangeAndTarget: One living target with your Bleed within 60 ft
cards.effect: Apply your Blood Mark. Replaces your previous mark without detonating it. The mark enables Rupture and printed mark interactions; it deals no automatic damage and does not grant vision.

source.originalText: Blood Mark: Apply a magical mark to a bleeding target that lasts for 5 turns. The mark can be detonated for additional effects.

cards.name: Shroud
cards.duration: Until end next turn or attack/cast/bright light
cards.effect: Become invisible while in dim light or darkness. Attacking, casting a spell or entering bright light ends it. You must still Hide to conceal your location. Audible movement can reveal your position.

source.originalText: Shroud: Enter stealth mode, becoming invisible to enemies until you attack or move into bright light. Limited uses per encounter.

cards.name: Vital Sense
cards.rangeAndTarget: Living creatures within 60 ft, excluding total cover
cards.effect: Sense presence and approximate direction, not identity or thoughts. Once during this minute, gain advantage on one weapon attack against a sensed creature you can otherwise legally target. This does not change critical range.

source.originalText: Vital Sense: Heighten your senses for 1 minute, allowing you to detect the presence of living creatures within 60 feet and see their vital points more clearly (+10% critical hit chance).

cards.name: Blood Echo
cards.effect: Your Bleed can have two independent instances on a creature; a third application refreshes the oldest. Once on each of your turns add 1 to one Bleed instance's next tick. Never spread or detonate more instances than actually exist.

source.originalText: Blood Echo: Bleeds now stack twice and deal +10% more damage.

cards.name: Bio-Alchemical Flow
cards.effect: Activating a self-only Veinweave does not itself end your hidden state or Shroud. Its normal visible effects may reveal you; attacks, spells and other hostile effects still break hiding normally.

source.originalText: Bio-Alchemical Flow: Veinweaves do not break stealth.

cards.name: Spill Control
cards.effect: Blood Gauge capacity rises from 3 to 6. Gain rate is unchanged. This replaces, rather than adds to, the old cap. No BG is granted merely by learning it.

source.originalText: Spill Control: Max Blood Gauge increased to 6.

cards.name: Rupture Trigger
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 2 other enemies within 5 ft of ruptured mark
cards.effect: After Rupture damages its marked target, choose up to 2 other living enemies nearby. Each makes CON save; on failure apply one Bleed. These applications do not trigger Rupture again or grant BG.

source.originalText: Rupture Trigger: Detonating a Blood Mark causes AoE Bleed in a small radius.

cards.name: Crimson Flow
cards.effect: After spending BG, gain+5 ft Speed. Your next weapon damage roll before end next turn adds 1. Repeated expenditures refresh rather than stack; no attack-speed or additional-Action benefit.

source.originalText: Crimson Flow: Using Blood Gauge grants +10% movement and attack speed for 2 turns.

cards.name: Crimson Harmony
cards.effect: You may sustain two Veinweaves as one concentration group. Both pay full costs and use normal activations; failing concentration ends both. Identical Veinweaves never stack, and no ordinary concentration spell can join this group.

source.originalText: Crimson Harmony: Maintain 2 Veinweaves simultaneously.

cards.name: Bloodbound Edge
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies with your Bleed within 30 ft
cards.effect: End up to 2 of your Bleed instances per target. Each takes 1d4 per remaining tick, maximum S d4 per creature, ignoring resistance but respecting immunity. This replaces their future ticks and grants no BG, healing or kill-trigger benefit.

source.originalText: Capstone – Bloodbound Edge: Once per rest, convert all Bleeds on enemies to instant True Damage.

cards.name: Veinweave: Bloodshield
cards.effect: Start Bloodshield Veinweave. Gain temporary HP equal to class level+M. Once while they remain, use Reaction to reduce damage to yourself by S. No self-damage refund or BG is generated.

source.originalText: Veinweave: Bloodshield: Consume 2 Blood Gauge points to create a protective barrier that absorbs damage equal to 20% of your maximum health.

cards.name: Rupture
cards.effect: Target makes CON save: (S+1)d8 necrotic on failure, half on success. The mark ends either way; existing Bleed remains. Damage from this technique is not a weapon hit and grants no BG.

source.originalText: Rupture: Detonate a Blood Mark on a target, dealing significant damage and consuming the mark.

cards.name: Bloodtrail
cards.rangeAndTarget: One living target with your Bleed within 30 ft
cards.effect: Know the direction to the target while within 1 mile on the same plane. Total distance and a trail are not shown. Lead barriers or effects that block divination block this sense; it grants no attack advantage or targeting through cover.

source.originalText: Bloodtrail: Mark a bleeding target, allowing you to track them perfectly for 1 hour regardless of distance or obstacles.

cards.name: Veinweave: Sensory Theft
cards.rangeAndTarget: One living creature with your Bleed within 60 ft
cards.effect: Target makes WIS save. Failure lets you see and hear through it while it remains within 1 mile on the same plane; you are blind/deaf to your own surroundings. It repeats save at the end of each of its turns and the first time each round it takes damage. No control or thought reading.

source.originalText: Veinweave: Sensory Theft: Consume 2 Blood Gauge points to briefly experience what a bleeding target sees and hears.

cards.name: Hemostasis
cards.effect: End all Bleed on the target and restore S d6+M HP, regardless of number of ticks removed. You cannot create extra healing by inflicting extra Bleed. Works even if no Bleed is present, at the same RP cost.

source.originalText: Hemostasis: Stop all bleeding effects on yourself or an ally, converting each remaining turn of Bleed into a small amount of healing.

cards.name: Bloodbond
cards.effect: Create Bloodbond while both remain within 30 ft. When ally takes damage, you may use Reaction to redirect floor(one-quarter of pre-mitigation damage) to yourself; each recipient applies its own defenses once. Once/round when a paid technique heals you, ally gains M temporary HP. No recursive transfers.

source.originalText: Bloodbond: Link with an ally; share 25% incoming damage and transfer 10% healing to them.

cards.name: Hemostasis
cards.rangeAndTarget: One willing living ally in range of your Bleed application
cards.effect: You may replace a new Bleed application on that ally with healing 1d4 at start of its next 3 turns. Pay extra RP even if original application was free. One such healing effect per target; it cannot spread, detonate, generate BG or trigger healing loops.

source.originalText: Hemostasis: Bleeds applied to allies now heal them instead.

cards.name: Protective Flow
cards.rangeAndTarget: Allies actually affected by your Veinweaves
cards.effect: An affected ally gains+1 to saves and reduces each damage instance by 2, minimum 0. This benefit does not stack across Veinweaves or Agents. Self-only Veinweaves cannot be extended merely by this passive.

source.originalText: Protective Flow: Allies affected by your Veinweaves gain 10% DR and +1 to all saves.

cards.name: Veinlock Tether
cards.rangeAndTarget: Willing linked ally within 30 ft being damaged
cards.effect: While your Bloodbond or Vitality Link is active, redirect up to S+M damage to yourself before mitigation. This is an alternative to Bloodbond's quarter-sharing reaction, not an additional redirection. Redirected damage cannot be redirected again.

source.originalText: Veinlock Tether: Form a damage-sharing link with an ally for 3 turns.

cards.name: Crimson Pact
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 bleeding enemies and 6 living allies within 30 ft
cards.effect: End your Bleeds on chosen enemies; each makes CON save against 4d8 necrotic, half on success. Each chosen ally regains 4d8+M HP and gains 10 temporary HP. Use one shared roll per damage/healing effect; healing does not multiply by enemies or remaining ticks.

source.originalText: Final Cut – Crimson Pact: Detonate all enemy Bleeds to heal nearby allies and grant them barriers. (1/day)

cards.name: Transfusion
cards.cost: 2 RP; sacrifice up to class level HP
cards.effect: Lose K real HP, at least 1, without falling below 1. Ally regains K+floor(K/2) HP. Loss bypasses defenses and cannot trigger BG, damage-sharing or healing refunds. The RP/use limit remains even if little healing is possible.

source.originalText: Transfusion: Transfer health from yourself to an ally, healing them for 150% of the health sacrificed.

cards.name: Veinweave: Vitality Link
cards.effect: Start Vitality Link Veinweave. Once/round when you restore real HP with a paid Agent technique, linked ally regains M HP if within 30 ft. This secondary healing never triggers another link. Gain+1 AC while adjacent to that ally; no spell buffs or resources are copied.

source.originalText: Veinweave: Vitality Link: Consume 3 Blood Gauge points to link with an ally, sharing beneficial effects and healing for 3 turns.

cards.name: Blood Ward
cards.rangeAndTarget: Fixed 10 ft radius centered within 30 ft, up to 3 allies
cards.effect: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or necrotic. Selected allies within the zone gain resistance to that damage type. Leaving loses the benefit; reentering restores it. Identical resistance does not stack. This is not a Veinweave.

source.originalText: Blood Ward: Create a protective circle using blood magic that shields allies within from certain types of damage or effects.

cards.name: Purify Blood
cards.effect: End Poisoned and one nonmagical disease. Magical disease needs a successful INT ability check against its stated treatment DC, or DC 15 if absent; failure spends the cost. No curse, Wound, death or Corruption removal.

source.originalText: Purify Blood: Remove poison, disease, or other blood-borne afflictions from a target.

cards.name: Lifewell
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 living allies within 15 ft
cards.effect: Spend K BG. At start and on each of your next 2 turns, use Bonus Action and pay 1 RP to pulse healing: each chosen ally still within 15 ft regains 1d8+K HP. Without maintenance it ends at turn end. Total 3 pulses; no triggers create more BG.

source.originalText: Lifewell: Ultimate ability that converts all your remaining Blood Gauge into a powerful healing aura for allies.

cards.name: Ghost Vein
cards.effect: A weapon hit made from hidden ignores resistance to that weapon's damage type for this hit. Immunity remains. This does not bypass armor or make the attack automatically hit.

source.originalText: Ghost Vein: Attacks from stealth ignore 25% of target resistances.

cards.name: Blackout Agent
cards.rangeAndTarget: Attacker within 30 ft that missed you
cards.effect: Attacker makes CON save; failure Blinded. Requires it can see you. Each creature becomes immune to your Blackout Agent until encounter end after resolving this save, preventing repeated blind-lock.

source.originalText: Blackout Agent: Dodging an attack blinds the attacker for 1 turn.

cards.name: Ghostflow Reflexes
cards.effect: Gain+1 AC. Once/round after a Veinweave starts, shorten one OTHER positive Agent cooldown by 1; this uses that ability's reset allowance. It grants no critical immunity, actions or per-rest uses.

source.originalText: Ghostflow Reflexes: While Veinweave is active: +5% dodge, cooldowns -1, +10% crit resistance.

cards.name: Veinjammer
cards.rangeAndTarget: One creature damaged by your Bleed
cards.effect: After a Bleed tick, choose that victim: Speed reduced 5 ft, minimum 0, and its next concentration save takes-1. Nonstacking; does not remove an Action or prohibit spellcasting.

source.originalText: Veinjammer: Bleeds reduce enemy casting and action speed by 10%.

cards.name: Total Silence
cards.effect: Each makes CON save. Failure prevents verbal spellcasting and Reactions, and suppresses one passive bonus to AC or attack rolls chosen from an observed effect. It never removes innate anatomy, immunities, legendary rules or class resource pools. Success prevents all effects; no whole-sheet passive disable.

source.originalText: Final Cut – Total Silence: AoE disables all enemy passives and silences for 2 turns.

cards.name: Phantom Strike
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy in weapon reach; must be hidden from it
cards.effect: Make one weapon attack with advantage. On hit add S d6 damage and apply a mark without its usual BG cost, even if not already bleeding. The mark replaces your old mark; no free Rupture occurs. Normal hit BG gain still capped.

source.originalText: Phantom Strike: Attack from stealth with increased critical chance and apply a Blood Mark automatically.

cards.name: Veinweave: Shadow Meld
cards.effect: Start Shadow Meld Veinweave: advantage on Stealth and invisible while motionless in dim light/darkness. Moving removes invisibility until start next turn; attacking or casting ends the Veinweave. No concealment against blindsight or effects that expressly reveal invisibility.

source.originalText: Veinweave: Shadow Meld: Consume 3 Blood Gauge points to become nearly undetectable for 1 minute, gaining enhanced stealth capabilities.

cards.name: Disrupt Flow
cards.effect: CON save: failure prevents Reactions and gives disadvantage on its next spell attack. If concentrating, make an additional normal concentration save versus your class DC. This never disables all special abilities or guarantees a failed concentration check.

source.originalText: Disrupt Flow: Temporarily disable a target's special abilities by disrupting their vital energies.

cards.name: Blood Cipher
cards.rangeAndTarget: One willing or restrained living target with your Bleed touched
cards.effect: Target makes WIS save unless willing. On failure learn one factual sensory memory from the last 24 hours about a stated event; the target chooses a relevant memory if several exist. Success yields no information. No beliefs, absolute truth or unrelated secrets are guaranteed.

source.originalText: Blood Cipher: Extract information directly from a bleeding target's blood, potentially learning secrets or weaknesses.

cards.name: Blackout
cards.effect: Create magical darkness blocking ordinary sight and darkvision. You can see within it up to 30 ft. Creatures can leave normally; no automatic damage, surprise or advantage when another sense locates you. Enemies still act and make saves normally.

source.originalText: Blackout: Ultimate ability that creates a zone of magical darkness where only you can see clearly, granting significant advantages.

cards.name: Blood Frenzy
cards.effect: Add 1 to direct weapon damage per hostile creature bearing your Bleed, maximum 3. Applies once per hit, not per Bleed instance. Secondary Bleed, copies and explosions gain no bonus.

source.originalText: Blood Frenzy: +5% damage per enemy actively bleeding (max +25%).

cards.name: Hemorrhagic Plague
cards.rangeAndTarget: One new living enemy within 5 ft of a Bleed victim
cards.effect: After one of your Bleeds ticks, pay 1 BG; new target makes CON save. Failure applies one Bleed. A spread instance cannot spread again. This grants no BG and does not duplicate marks or immediate damage.

source.originalText: Hemorrhagic Plague: Bleeds automatically spread to nearby enemies every 3 turns.

cards.name: Pain-to-Power Conduction
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy within 5 ft after it damages you
cards.effect: End one active Veinweave. Chosen enemy makes CON save: failure takes S d4 necrotic and Bleed; success takes half immediate damage only. On failure by 10 it is Frightened until end next turn. No resource refund.

source.originalText: Pain-to-Power Conduction: Veinweaves explode when struck, dealing AoE Bleed and minor Fear.

cards.name: Carrion Conductor
cards.rangeAndTarget: One fresh hostile living-combatant corpse within 30 ft
cards.effect: Mark the corpse once; on activation or before expiry use Reaction to burst it. Up to 3 enemies within 5 ft make DEX saves: S d6 necrotic, half on success. Corpse cannot be reused, raised by this effect or provide BG/kill triggers.

source.originalText: Carrion Conductor: Corpses leave behind blood pools that explode for AoE damage.

cards.name: Veinburst Requiem
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 6 enemies with your Bleed within 30 ft
cards.effect: Spend K BG and end your Bleeds on targets. CON save: (S+K)d8 necrotic, half on success. A target failing by 10 with remaining HP no greater than your class level falls to 0; ordinary death rules follow. No percentage-based automatic boss execution or BG refund.

source.originalText: Final Cut – Veinburst Requiem: Detonates all Bleeds and Blood Gauge effects in range. Enemies under 25% HP are instantly executed. (1/day)

cards.name: Exsanguinate
cards.effect: CON save: (S+1)d8 necrotic, half on success; add 1d8 if it has your Bleed. If it fails and actually takes damage, regain 1 BG within the common gain cap. The refund cannot pay activation costs retroactively.

source.originalText: Exsanguinate: Violently extract blood from a target, dealing heavy damage to bleeding enemies and generating additional Blood Gauge.

cards.name: Veinweave: Blood Frenzy
cards.effect: Start Blood Frenzy Veinweave: once on your turn add S d6 to one weapon hit; gain+10 ft Speed and suffer-2 AC. No extra attacks, Actions or critical range. Ending early removes both benefit and penalty.

source.originalText: Veinweave: Blood Frenzy: Consume 3 Blood Gauge points to enter a frenzied state, increasing damage and attack speed but reducing defense.

cards.name: Blood Boil
cards.duration: Instant; control until end next turn
cards.effect: CON save: (S+1)d6 fire, half on success. On failure target loses Reactions; on failure by 10 also Stunned until end its next turn. The Stun uses the shared hard-denial guard across all this character’s features. If this character already hard-denied that target this encounter, only damage and the non-hard-denial rider resolve.

source.originalText: Blood Boil: Cause a target's blood to heat rapidly, dealing internal damage and potentially stunning them.

cards.name: Crimson Harvest
cards.rangeAndTarget: One enemy in weapon reach at half HP or less
cards.effect: Make one weapon attack; on hit add S d8 damage. If this reduces it to 0, regain S+M HP and 1 BG within gain cap. No instant kill from a percentage threshold; summoned/allied/helpless creatures yield no recovery.

source.originalText: Crimson Harvest: Execute a heavily wounded target, restoring health and Blood Gauge based on the target's missing health.

cards.name: Bloodstorm
cards.rangeAndTarget: Moving 10 ft aura around self, up to 3 enemies per pulse
cards.effect: On start and each later paid pulse, targets make CON saves: S d6 necrotic, half on success; failure applies one Bleed. Maintenance costs Bonus Action+1 RP. Maximum 3 pulses. Once/turn your direct weapon attack against a creature in the storm adds 1 damage; storm/bleed damage gives no BG.

source.originalText: Bloodstorm: Ultimate ability that creates a swirling vortex of blood, dealing continuous damage to enemies and empowering your abilities.

fullClassSource.authoringNotes: Provisional; notebook adversarial findings reconciled and source-preserving editorial review complete. Human balance testing remains.

cards.name: Blood Mark
cards.rangeAndTarget: One living target with your Bleed within 60 ft
cards.effect: Apply your Blood Mark. Replaces your previous mark without detonating it. The mark enables Rupture and printed mark interactions; it deals no automatic damage and does not grant vision.

source.originalText: Blood Mark: Apply a magical mark to a bleeding target that lasts for 5 turns. The mark can be detonated for additional effects.

cards.name: Hemorrhage Slash
cards.effect: Make one weapon attack. On hit add S d6 damage of the weapon type and apply Bleed. The usual once/turn hit trigger grants 1 BG; this card grants no separate BG.

source.originalText: Hemorrhage Slash: A precise strike that deals moderate damage and applies Bleed status to the target, generating 1 Blood Gauge point.

cards.name: Shroud
cards.duration: Until end next turn or attack/cast/bright light
cards.effect: Become invisible while in dim light or darkness. Attacking, casting a spell or entering bright light ends it. You must still Hide to conceal your location. Audible movement can reveal your position.

source.originalText: Shroud: Enter stealth mode, becoming invisible to enemies until you attack or move into bright light. Limited uses per encounter.

cards.name: Veinweave: Quickblood
cards.effect: Start a Veinweave: gain+10 ft Speed and ignore nonmagical difficult terrain. Once during its duration you may draw or stow one weapon without using your object interaction. It grants no attacks or Actions.

source.originalText: Veinweave: Quickblood: Consume 1 Blood Gauge point to increase your movement and attack speed by 15% for 3 turns.

cards.name: Vital Sense
cards.rangeAndTarget: Living creatures within 60 ft, excluding total cover
cards.effect: Sense presence and approximate direction, not identity or thoughts. Once during this minute, gain advantage on one weapon attack against a sensed creature you can otherwise legally target. This does not change critical range.

source.originalText: Vital Sense: Heighten your senses for 1 minute, allowing you to detect the presence of living creatures within 60 feet and see their vital points more clearly (+10% critical hit chance).

cards.name: Arterial Cut
cards.effect: A critical weapon hit applies your Bleed. If it already has your Bleed, extend one instance by 2 ticks, maximum 5 ticks remaining. This damage never generates further BG.

source.originalText: Arterial Cut: Critical hits apply Bleed for 3 turns; Bleed duration +2 turns.

cards.name: Hemostasis
cards.effect: End all Bleed on the target and restore S d6+M HP, regardless of number of ticks removed. You cannot create extra healing by inflicting extra Bleed. Works even if no Bleed is present, at the same RP cost.

source.originalText: Hemostasis: Stop all bleeding effects on yourself or an ally, converting each remaining turn of Bleed into a small amount of healing.

cards.name: Rupture
cards.effect: Target makes CON save: (S+1)d8 necrotic on failure, half on success. The mark ends either way; existing Bleed remains. Damage from this technique is not a weapon hit and grants no BG.

source.originalText: Rupture: Detonate a Blood Mark on a target, dealing significant damage and consuming the mark.

cards.name: Veinweave: Bloodshield
cards.effect: Start Bloodshield Veinweave. Gain temporary HP equal to class level+M. Once while they remain, use Reaction to reduce damage to yourself by S. No self-damage refund or BG is generated.

source.originalText: Veinweave: Bloodshield: Consume 2 Blood Gauge points to create a protective barrier that absorbs damage equal to 20% of your maximum health.

cards.name: Bloodtrail
cards.rangeAndTarget: One living target with your Bleed within 30 ft
cards.effect: Know the direction to the target while within 1 mile on the same plane. Total distance and a trail are not shown. Lead barriers or effects that block divination block this sense; it grants no attack advantage or targeting through cover.

source.originalText: Bloodtrail: Mark a bleeding target, allowing you to track them perfectly for 1 hour regardless of distance or obstacles.

cards.name: Bio-Alchemical Flow
cards.effect: Activating a self-only Veinweave does not itself end your hidden state or Shroud. Its normal visible effects may reveal you; attacks, spells and other hostile effects still break hiding normally.

source.originalText: Bio-Alchemical Flow: Veinweaves do not break stealth.

cards.name: Veinweave: Sensory Theft
cards.rangeAndTarget: One living creature with your Bleed within 60 ft
cards.effect: Target makes WIS save. Failure lets you see and hear through it while it remains within 1 mile on the same plane; you are blind/deaf to your own surroundings. It repeats save at the end of each of its turns and the first time each round it takes damage. No control or thought reading.

source.originalText: Veinweave: Sensory Theft: Consume 2 Blood Gauge points to briefly experience what a bleeding target sees and hears.

cards.name: Blood Echo
cards.effect: Your Bleed can have two independent instances on a creature; a third application refreshes the oldest. Once on each of your turns add 1 to one Bleed instance's next tick. Never spread or detonate more instances than actually exist.

source.originalText: Blood Echo: Bleeds now stack twice and deal +10% more damage.

cards.name: Crimson Flow
cards.effect: After spending BG, gain+5 ft Speed. Your next weapon damage roll before end next turn adds 1. Repeated expenditures refresh rather than stack; no attack-speed or additional-Action benefit.

source.originalText: Crimson Flow: Using Blood Gauge grants +10% movement and attack speed for 2 turns.

cards.name: Bloodbond
cards.effect: Create Bloodbond while both remain within 30 ft. When ally takes damage, you may use Reaction to redirect floor(one-quarter of pre-mitigation damage) to yourself; each recipient applies its own defenses once. Once/round when a paid technique heals you, ally gains M temporary HP. No recursive transfers.

source.originalText: Bloodbond: Link with an ally; share 25% incoming damage and transfer 10% healing to them.

cards.name: Transfusion
cards.cost: 2 RP; sacrifice up to class level HP
cards.effect: Lose K real HP, at least 1, without falling below 1. Ally regains K+floor(K/2) HP. Loss bypasses defenses and cannot trigger BG, damage-sharing or healing refunds. The RP/use limit remains even if little healing is possible.

source.originalText: Transfusion: Transfer health from yourself to an ally, healing them for 150% of the health sacrificed.

cards.name: Crimson Harmony
cards.effect: You may sustain two Veinweaves as one concentration group. Both pay full costs and use normal activations; failing concentration ends both. Identical Veinweaves never stack, and no ordinary concentration spell can join this group.

source.originalText: Crimson Harmony: Maintain 2 Veinweaves simultaneously.

cards.name: Blood Ward
cards.rangeAndTarget: Fixed 10 ft radius centered within 30 ft, up to 3 allies
cards.effect: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning or necrotic. Selected allies within the zone gain resistance to that damage type. Leaving loses the benefit; reentering restores it. Identical resistance does not stack. This is not a Veinweave.

source.originalText: Blood Ward: Create a protective circle using blood magic that shields allies within from certain types of damage or effects.

cards.name: Rupture Trigger
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 2 other enemies within 5 ft of ruptured mark
cards.effect: After Rupture damages its marked target, choose up to 2 other living enemies nearby. Each makes CON save; on failure apply one Bleed. These applications do not trigger Rupture again or grant BG.

source.originalText: Rupture Trigger: Detonating a Blood Mark causes AoE Bleed in a small radius.

cards.name: Purify Blood
cards.effect: End Poisoned and one nonmagical disease. Magical disease needs a successful INT ability check against its stated treatment DC, or DC 15 if absent; failure spends the cost. No curse, Wound, death or Corruption removal.

source.originalText: Purify Blood: Remove poison, disease, or other blood-borne afflictions from a target.

automaticCards.name: Bloodbound Edge
automaticCards.cost: 3 BG; 1 short-rest use
automaticCards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 enemies with your Bleed within 30 ft
automaticCards.effect: End up to 2 of your Bleed instances per target. Each takes 1d4 per remaining tick, maximum S d4 per creature, ignoring resistance but respecting immunity. This replaces their future ticks and grants no BG, healing or kill-trigger benefit.

source.originalText: Capstone – Bloodbound Edge: Once per rest, convert all Bleeds on enemies to instant True Damage.

fullClassSource.protectedInterfaceOriginal: Smite, Aura, and Lay on Hands are Oath mechanics and do not generate Weave Dissonance. After a successful melee hit, the next Oath spell before the end of the next turn generates 1 less Dissonance.
engine: Charisma governs Oath DC/M and divine technique attacks. Weapon attacks use their ordinary Strength/Dexterity ability. Hit Die d10; all armor, shields, simple and martial weapons. Paladin has no Conviction or Oracle Revelation Charges. Lay on Hands is its own pool, 5×Paladin level, fully restored only by long rest. Ordinary spells and printed Smite fuel use the same Paladin Core V 2 RP pool; healing points never convert to RP.

Base progression is explicit rather than the ordinary 25-card template: at 1 automatically gain Lay on Hands, Divine Sense, Martial Proficiency, Divine Strike, Protective Stance and Sacred Touch. At 2 gain Righteous Challenge, Bolstering Presence, Fighting Style and ordinary Paladin spell access. At 3 swear ONE of ten Oaths; gain only its Smite modification, Aura and first Revelation spell. This Oath is the Arch specialization. At 10 enter Hero Oath Mastery of that SAME Oath; no second Oath or additional generic Hero tree. Signature Power unlocks 11, Final Gift 20. Oath Revelations automatically unlock 3/5/9/13/17, always known in addition to the shared spell repertoire, rank 1/2/3/4/5 respectively. Exact printed RP costs replace generic cost only if the card explicitly supplies them.

At 2 choose one Fighting Style: Defense +1 AC while armored; Dueling +2 damage to first one-handed melee hit on your own turn; Protection Reaction impose disadvantage on one attack against an adjacent ally when using a shield. At 3 Divine Health gives advantage on disease saves, not universal immunity. At 5 Extra Attack makes two attacks when taking the ordinary Attack Action; named attack techniques use their own counts. These three features reconcile preserved main-registry entries; other old level-table extras, including extra level 14 ASI and undefined free slot riders, are not stacked into this draft. ASI/feat at 4/8/12/16/19 follows general advancement once.

Divine Strike at 1: after one melee weapon hit on your regular turn, spend 1 RP to add S d6 radiant. At 2 this becomes Divine Smite: choose 1 RP for S d6 or 2 RP for(S+1)d8 radiant, once/own turn total. Oath 3 changes type/rider as its card states, never adds another copy of the base damage. Smite is not an ordinary spell, cannot be counterspelled or generically Overcast, and causes no Dissonance. A critical hit doubles Smite damage dice under ordinary rules, but never healing, resources or percentage copies.

One Oath aura, requires consciousness and no concentration. Radius 10 ft at 3, 15 ft at 6, 20 ft at 10, 30 ft at 15. Benefits affect up to 3 allies or 3 enemies as the Oath card states, chosen at start of your turn and changed next turn; they must stay within aura. At 6 choose one additional aura benefit for that day: allies+1 saves against fear/charm, or 1 flat DR against weapon damage. At 7 once/short rest when enemy damages an ally in aura, Reaction make one melee attack if in reach; may pay normal Smite cost even off turn, but total Smite maximum one per round from this reactive feature. At 10 aura persists until start of your next regular turn after incapacitation; then ends if still incapacitated. At 15 also grant selected allies+1 initiative while in aura when initiative is rolled; no retroactive turn changes.

At 17 Aura Surge once/short rest Bonus Action: until start next turn choose up to 3 allies in aura to gain S+M temporary HP and+1 saves. This bounded surge replaces vague doubling of every aura number. At 20 Divine Manifestation makes the aura active upon initiative without an action, radius 30 ft; it ignores ordinary Silence and terrain obstruction between allies but not antimagic explicitly suppressing divine powers, planar barriers or the consciousness rule. Source cannot-be-suppressed language is bounded explicitly. It grants no free Signature, Smite or Revelation spell.

Protected interface: Smite, Aura and Lay on Hands generate no Weave Dissonance. After a successful direct melee hit, your next Oath spell before end next turn generates 1 less Dissonance, minimum 0, consuming the benefit. No stacking, RP discount or Refrain reset. Oath Revelation spells and the five replacement Forbidden spells below are ordinary spells for strain, countering and concentration; signature powers and final gifts are Oath techniques unless expressly tagged otherwise.

Oath conduct clauses remain intact in source and Oath cards. The Director identifies a relevant clause and a knowingly chosen serious breach before applying a fall. A disagreement, failed roll, coerced act or unknown fact does not silently remove a character. A fall is an explicit story transition recorded with the player: choose the corresponding Oathbreaker inversion or pursue an agreed restoration scene. Preserve class level and already spent resources. Oathbreaker replaces its Oath Aura, Smite rider, Signature and Revelation list, rather than stacking both sets. Base martial abilities remain; Lay on Hands becomes Death Touch using the same current 5 L pool, with no refill on switching.

Death Touch baseline: Action melee divine attack PB+CHA; declare and spend 1 through 2 S+M points before the attack from remaining Lay on Hands pool to deal that much necrotic damage (choose amount before roll; miss still spends declared points). Each Oath inversion may alter type or add its bounded rider; never copy innate traits, confiscate class engines or automatically execute a target. A listed inverted Signature is available only at 11 and replaces the ordinary Signature use, one/short rest. An inverted aura follows the same radius, target cap and timing. Oathbreaker 20 uses the new Black Manifestation common capstone instead of its original Final Gift.

The source names a Forbidden Spell List but does not supply five complete entries for each inversion. This pilot explicitly adds one shared five-spell replacement list (below), with each Oathbreaker using its inversion name as flavor. These are new test rules, not recovered historical spells. Choose the normal Oath package OR inverted package at a time. All later Oath prerequisites still use Paladin class level; the Oathbreaker label does not bypass 3/11/20 gates.

Oath integration limits: one paid Smite total per round, including the level-7 Reaction; one Oath-aura reactive event per round. Multiple damage-redirection options share one event per round unless Crown Undying expressly allows two. Apply original-target defenses once, then split actual damage; transferred damage cannot be mitigated again, reflected, redirected again or generate resources. This explicit rule supersedes wording that permits recipient defenses again.

Sustained Oath spell damage/healing zones use concentration, at most three pulses, and 1 RP upkeep after the first pulse unless a priced card expressly supplies a different finite cadence. Native Oath auras retain their printed passive cadence and target cap. Final auras last their stated finite duration and include their pulses. All hard-denial effects, including compelled Actions, share the common once/source/target/encounter guard; later failures only remove Reactions and reduce Speed by half for one turn.

An emergency Reaction whose trigger itself incapacitates you, such as Grace Reversal or Thorn Crown, may resolve before that incapacitation only if you had a Reaction available before the triggering event. This grants no other actions while incapacitated. Narrative labels such as oppressor require a specific act of captivity/coercion established in the scene, not an alignment or identity assumption.

The source ceiling’s half-pool-per-round Lay on Hands cap is a preserved alternative. This pilot instead uses maximum class level per ordinary Lay on Hands Action and the explicitly once-per-long-rest level-17 Wave that distributes the current remaining pool. No normal heal gains the Wave’s exception.

For any one damage event choose exactly one Paladin redirection feature. Using it consumes the shared redirection allowance for that round. Crown Undying permits two DIFFERENT ally-damage events per round, but still only one redirection feature may modify each event.
workedExample: Paladin 5 Mercy, STR 16 CHA 16 PB 3 S 2 M 3: RP 6, Lay on Hands 25, two ordinary Attack Action attacks. Aura radius 10 ft until Paladin 6.
Turn 1 Attack Action: first hit permits 2 RP Smite, RP 6→4, adding 3d8 radiant. Second weapon hit receives no second Smite from this activation. Mercy healing uses only its printed bounded rider.
Turn 2 Action Lay on Hands spends 5 points to heal 5 HP, pool 25→20; it does not cost RP or add Dissonance. Bonus Action Protective Stance uses its own short-rest allowance; no free attack.
Turn 3 ordinary Attack Action hits. This primes the protected 1 D reduction for an Oath spell before end next turn; it does not refund 2 RP already spent or remove existing strain.

Turn 4 cast a rank 1 Oath Revelation for its printed 2 RP: RP 4→2 before strain surcharge, base 1 D becomes 0 from the primed hit. If immediately repeating the same spell, its Refrain still contributes after the single 1 D reduction.
At encounter end Lay on Hands remains 20 and RP 2. Short rest Retune restores RP by the shared formula up to 6, but never refills healing pool; long rest restores 25.
balanceQuestions: Is each Oath distinct at3 before its Signature at11?
Are Lay on Hands and RP meaningful separate budgets?
Does an Oathbreaker replacement preserve a playable character without stacking both packages?

cards.name: Lay on Hands
cards.cost: Choose 1 or more Lay on Hands points, maximum L per Action
cards.effect: Restore 1 HP per point spent, maximum class level per activation. Alternatively spend 5 points to end Poisoned or allow one immediate save against an existing disease that permits saves; cannot erase special-quest diseases, Wounds or death. This is finite pool healing, no RP conversion.

source.originalText: Lay on Hands: Healing pool equal to 5 × your Paladin level; can heal or remove conditions.

cards.name: Divine Sense
cards.effect: Know presence, number and direction of celestials, fiends and undead not behind total cover. Does not reveal identity, thoughts, moral alignment or ordinary hidden humanoids. At 18 reveals eligible disguised outsiders through mundane/magical disguises, still no total cover penetration.

source.originalText: Divine Sense: Detect the presence of celestial, fiendish, or undead entities within 60 feet.

cards.name: Martial Proficiency
cards.effect: Proficient with all simple/martial weapons, all armor and shields. Does not grant a second fighting style, extra attack, proficiency in every tool or double armor/shield bonuses.

source.originalText: Martial Proficiency: Proficiency with all armor types, shields, and weapons.

cards.name: Divine Strike
cards.effect: Use engine Divine Strike/Smite dice and later Oath modification. Declare after hit, then pay; normal critical dice rules. Not a spell and produces no Dissonance. Cannot trigger from reflected/copy/companion damage.

source.originalText: Divine Strike: Channel divine energy into your weapon attacks, dealing additional damage.

cards.name: Protective Stance
cards.effect: Gain+1 AC. Once before end, Reaction interpose for adjacent ally hit by weapon: reduce its damage by S+M and take that much unpreventable damage yourself. Cannot redirect again or create resource/damage triggers. You must remain conscious.

source.originalText: Protective Stance: Enter a defensive posture that increases your AC and allows you to intercept attacks meant for nearby allies.

cards.name: Righteous Challenge
cards.effect: WIS save; failure disadvantage on attacks against other creatures while it can perceive you. It may move, use nonattack actions or decline attacks; no compelled suicide, belief change or full turn loss.

source.originalText: Righteous Challenge: Mark an enemy, forcing them to focus on you or suffer penalties.

cards.name: Bolstering Presence
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 allies 15 ft who can perceive you
cards.effect: Each gains+2 on its next save against Charmed or Frightened and M temporary HP. Use strongest save bonus from same class; does not end existing conditions automatically.

source.originalText: Bolstering Presence: Inspire nearby allies, granting them temporary bonuses to saves against fear and charm effects.

cards.name: Sacred Touch
cards.effect: Stabilize a living Downed creature at 0 HP without healing; damage/ordinary rules can end stability. Alternatively pay 1 RP and examine 1 minute to learn whether one curse/disease affects it, without revealing origin or cure. No resurrection or free healing.

source.originalText: Sacred Touch: Channel divine energy to stabilize a dying creature or detect the presence of curses and diseases.

cards.name: Aura Scaling
cards.effect: Use exact radius, target cap, secondary benefit, reactive Smite, Aura Surge and Manifestation engine rules. Only chosen Oath aura applies; inverted aura replaces it. Multiple Paladin auras of same name do not stack numeric benefits.

source.originalText:
Aura Scaling
Level 3: 10 ft radius, base aura effect active while conscious
Level 6: 15 ft radius, gains secondary benefit (e.g., DR, saves)
Level 7: 15 ft radius, gain reactive Smite or spell trigger
Level 10: 20 ft radius, aura persists for 1 round if incapacitated
Level 15: 30 ft radius, aura debuffs enemies or buffs allies
Level 17: 30 ft radius, Aura Surge (1/rest) - double aura power or trigger burst effect
Level 20: 30+ ft radius, Divine Manifestation - aura auto-activates on initiative, cannot be suppressed

cards.name: Signature Power (Level 11)
cards.cost: One short-rest use plus printed cost
cards.effect: Automatically gain only your Oath's Signature, or corresponding inverted Signature if Oathbreaker. This unlock cannot be spent early as a Base/Arch selection. Rest references mean short rest unless card expressly long rest.

source.originalText:
Signature Power (Level 11)
Gain access to your Oath's Signature Power, a potent once-per-rest divine ability unique to your chosen Oath:

Mercy: Miracle Veil – Heal + Prevent death
Vengeance: Judgment Brand – Doom mark, bonus crit
Dominion: Heaven's Decree – Obey or suffer
Flame: Holy Inferno – AoE Smite purge
Ancients: Thorn Crown – Reflect status
Silence: Vow Unbroken – Bonus Smite if you stay silent
Chain: Warden's Lock – Lock enemies in zone
Grief: Final Vigil – Channel ally's power
Chains Broken: Righteous Quake – Break bindings, AoE push
Martyr King: Crown of Embers – Team-wide DR + damage redirection

cards.name: Divine Resistance (Level 13)
cards.effect: Choose fire, necrotic or psychic resistance. Same-type resistance does not stack. This is independent of Aura but does not automatically extend to allies.

source.originalText:
Divine Resistance (Level 13)
Choose one type of damage to gain resistance against: Fire, Necrotic, or Psychic.

cards.name: Lay on Hands
cards.cost: All remaining Lay on Hands points; minimum 1
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 living allies in aura
cards.effect: Allocate remaining points among targets, at least 1 each; restore 1 HP per point. You may instead allocate 5 points per target to end Poisoned or Frightened. Spend entire pool, cannot multiply it by recipient count, raise the dead or remove Wounds. Oathbreakers instead deal allocated necrotic damage to 3 enemies, CON half, same pool cost.

source.originalText:
Lay on Hands: Full Cleansing Wave (Level 17)
Once per rest, expend your entire Lay on Hands pool to create a wave of healing energy that affects all allies within your aura radius.

cards.name: Divine Sense
cards.effect: Divine Sense identifies celestial/fiend/undead nature despite ordinary disguise or shapeshift. Still requires clear line of effect; cannot reveal through walls or defeat artifact-specific concealment without its rule.

source.originalText:
Divine Sense: Detect Disguised Outsiders (Level 18)
Your Divine Sense now reveals outsiders (celestials, fiends, etc.) even if they are disguised or shapeshifted.

cards.name: Final Oath Gift (Level 20)
cards.cost: One long-rest use plus printed cost
cards.effect: Gain only your Oath's Final Gift. Oathbreaker instead gains Black Manifestation below. Do not grant all ten gifts, restore use by switching Oaths, or combine with another Final from different class level.

source.originalText:
Final Oath Gift (Level 20)
Receive the ultimate blessing of your Oath, a powerful capstone ability that represents the pinnacle of your divine connection.

cards.name: Fighting Style
cards.activation: Passive or Reaction, according to choice
cards.effect: Choose Defense, Dueling or Protection using the exact engine profiles. Do not choose another style when entering the Oath or Hero stage.

cards.name: Divine Health
cards.effect: Advantage on saving throws against disease; no automatic immunity or cure of existing disease.

cards.name: Extra Attack
cards.effect: Make two weapon attacks instead of one. Named techniques use printed counts. This does not create two Smite triggers beyond their per-turn cap.

cards.name: Blighted Benediction
cards.effect: New rank 1 Forbidden spell. Divine spell attack; hit S d8 necrotic and target-1 on next attack roll. No healing, command or second strike. Ordinary spell strain applies.

cards.name: Dread Shelter
cards.effect: New rank 2 Forbidden spell. Gain 2 S+M temporary HP on casting and 1 flat DR against weapon damage for duration. No recurring temp HP pulse or healing.

cards.name: Profane Exchange
cards.effect: New rank 3 Forbidden spell. You must have more current HP than the unpreventable HP cost. Target CON save, 2 S d8 necrotic on failure, half success. HP loss cannot be reduced, redirected, refunded or used for another resource trigger.

cards.name: Desecrated Ground
cards.cost: 7 RP start; 1 RP per later pulse
cards.rangeAndTarget: 10 ft radius fixed point 30 ft, up to 3 enemies
cards.effect: New rank 4 Forbidden spell. Initial and each paid pulse CON save for S d6 necrotic, half success. A failed target receives 1 less HP per healing die until start of your next turn. Penalty cannot make healing negative or stack with another same-stat reduction.

cards.name: Last Reproach
cards.activation: Reaction after an enemy damages an ally
cards.rangeAndTarget: That enemy 60 ft; one living ally in your aura
cards.effect: New rank 5 Forbidden spell. Enemy WIS save for 3 S d8 necrotic, half success; ally regains S d8 HP after triggering damage. Does not revive dead or undo conditions. Uses ordinary spell strain and your Reaction.

cards.name: Black Manifestation
cards.rangeAndTarget: Self and up to 3 enemies in aura
cards.effect: New Oathbreaker Final: gain 2 S+M temporary HP; chosen enemies WIS save or lose Reactions and Speed-10 ft for duration. Refresh one expended Signature use, then pay its normal Action and other costs when used. No Death Touch pool, RP, extra Action or Final reset.

cards.name: Merciful Smite
cards.cost: Use normal Divine Smite cost: 1 RP for S d6 or 2 RP for (S+1)d8
cards.rangeAndTarget: Creature hit by your melee weapon attack; up to 3 living allies within 10 feet of you
cards.frequency: One paid Smite total per round, shared with all normal and reactive Smite uses; any redirection uses its shared allowance
cards.effect: Your Oath Smite deals radiant damage instead of adding a second Smite packet. After the Smite damage resolves, create a healing pool equal to half the actual radiant Smite damage dealt, rounded down, maximum S+M. Divide that pool among up to 3 living allies within 10 feet. Healing cannot exceed maximum HP, remove Wounds or trigger additional Smite or healing-copy effects.

originalObjects.value: Radiant — bonus radiant damage; heals nearby allies for a portion dealt

conductClauses: Never refuse a genuine plea for healing or protection when the oath can answer it
Set the saving of life before the taking of it, even when anger makes the latter easier
Offer defeated foes the mercy their surrender can bear, without abandoning those still in danger
Do not raise lethal force against the innocent or defenseless; strength was given to stand between them and harm

cards.name: Aura of Mercy
cards.rangeAndTarget: Up to 3 chosen allies in your Oath aura
cards.duration: While conscious and target remains in aura
cards.frequency: Choose targets at start of each turn
cards.effect: The first time each round a selected ally receives HP healing from a finite or paid effect, add S HP. Each selected ally also reduces the first necrotic damage it takes each round by S. These benefits do not stack with another Aura of Mercy from the same source.

originalObjects.value: Aura of Mercy — allies gain increased healing received and resistance to necrotic damage

cards.name: Miracle Veil
cards.rangeAndTarget: One living ally in your Oath aura
cards.duration: Until start of your next regular turn
cards.effect: Trigger when the ally would be reduced below 1 HP by damage. Until the start of your next regular turn, that ally cannot be reduced below 1 HP by damage. oathCatalog.theme: Mercy is a shelter kept open in the worst hour: protection, healing, and the preservation of life before vengeance can make another wound.
conductClauses: Never refuse a genuine plea for healing or protection when the oath can answer it
Set the saving of life before the taking of it, even when anger makes the latter easier
Offer defeated foes the mercy their surrender can bear, without abandoning those still in danger
Do not raise lethal force against the innocent or defenseless; strength was given to stand between them and harm

oathCatalog.theme: Vengeance is judgment carried through the long road: fury disciplined into pursuit, execution held to a sworn account, and no refuge promised to the unrepentant.
conductClauses: Pursue sworn enemies until justice is served or they surrender; let no convenience excuse a broken charge
Do not abandon allies to feed a private vendetta, for judgment that leaves the faithful behind is only rage
Accept the surrender of those who genuinely repent, and hold them to the peace they have asked for

oathCatalog.theme: Authority held as a public burden: law spoken plainly, judgment bound to truth, and rulership measured by the safety it keeps
conductClauses: Uphold legitimate law and order, but do not call convenience or cruelty a lawful charge
Speak truth when acting as arbiter, and hear the whole matter before you command another
Do not use authority for personal gain; a decree that serves only its speaker has already failed the oath

oathCatalog.theme: A fire kept for cleansing rather than hunger: zeal tempered by restraint, corruption confronted, and renewal guarded after the ash
conductClauses: Purify corruption and undeath where found, but name the thing being purged before you raise the flame
Do not burn the innocent in zeal; fire that cannot distinguish harm from shelter has forsaken this oath
Accept that fire renews as well as destroys, and remain to protect what must grow after the burning

oathCatalog.theme: The living memory of the old places: nature guarded as a covenant, ancient power answered with humility, and renewal left possible for those who follow
conductClauses: Protect ancient places and living memory, especially where no living voice remains to speak for them
Do not destroy what cannot be restored; power does not excuse a wound made for haste
Honor pacts with fey and primal spirits, and do not mistake an old promise for permission to command

oathCatalog.theme: Humility, watchful restraint, and strength held in quiet
conductClauses: Speak when words serve the oath; let silence bear the rest
Do not claim glory for the work entrusted to you
Hear the whole matter before you judge it

oathCatalog.theme: A vigil of iron: martyrdom, warding, and the burden freely borne for another
conductClauses: Stand between the helpless and harm, even when the cost is yours to bear
Keep every ward entrusted to you; do not abandon the bound when danger closes
Take suffering freely to spare another, but never make a chain of their sacrifice

oathCatalog.theme: Sorrow, remembrance, and the duty of passage
conductClauses: Keep faith with the dead and with those they leave behind
Do not make sport of grief or profane a place of remembrance
Guide the departed toward rest; do not claim them for undeath

oathCatalog.theme: Liberty, the breaking of unjust bonds, and freedom guarded against a new tyranny
conductClauses: Break the bonds of the unjustly imprisoned, and do not turn liberation into license to abandon them
Resist every tyrant, including the one who would rule in freedom's name
Guard the newly freed from exploitation, for an open door is not yet a safe road

oathCatalog.theme: Stewardship, the burden of the crown, and sacrifice freely borne for those in your care
conductClauses: Bear the responsibility of command without treating those in your care as a means to your glory
Set the realm's need above personal gain, and spend your own strength before you spend another's
Never demand a burden you would not freely take upon yourself
